messages:
maya: quick q — need to grant external vendor temporary console access to debug a logging issue. ideal is 48h. what's the least-privileged way? project-scoped role or a custom role? also we prefer no raw PII in logs while they debug. @alex @sam

alex: for debugging logs i'd avoid org-level. create a project-scoped binding or a short-lived service account. if they need the console UI, roles/browser + roles/logging.viewer is the usual combo, but logging.viewer can surface payloads with PII. i'd prefer a custom role with only logging.logEntries.list, logging.logs.list, and maybe logging.sinks.get. explicitly do NOT give bigquery dataset access.

alex: we can add/remove binding via our infra scripts (ttl), but simple CLI example if you want to do manually:
```bash
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding my-project \
  --member='user:vendor@example.com' \
  --role='roles/logging.viewer'
# remove after 48h:
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding my-project \
  --member='user:vendor@example.com' \
  --role='roles/logging.viewer'
```

sam: :eyes: note that logging.viewer lets them see logPayloads which may include emails/IDs. if that's sensitive, route a copy of only relevant logs to a vendor-sandbox sink and run our log-scrubber (removes email, user_id, ip). i can stand up the pipeline. destination should be GCS/bq with very tight ACLs.

maya: ok — is creating a vendor-sandbox sink something we can do ourselves or do we need infra help?

sam: infra help for the sink wiring is easiest. high level steps: create sink with a filter for the service/resource, set destination, attach a cloud function/dataflow that scrub fields, grant only service-account-of-vendor read on the destination. example filter: `resource.type="k8s_container" AND textPayload:("order" OR "payment")`

leo: for audit trail, make a ticket in JIRA/#audit-requests with justification, exact expiration, and the log filters. security requires approver notes and a link to the scrub config. :thumbsup:

maya: who signs off? do we need 1 or 2 approvers for external vendors?

security-bot: Policy reminder: external vendor console access requires 2 approvers (eng-security + project owner) and ephemeral bindings <= 72h. Create JIT request here: https://idp.internal/jit-request and attach your ticket.

alex: once the ticket is open i can generate a custom role JSON and a removal script. also double-check there is no bigquery.dataViewer or storage.objectAdmin on the binding.

maya: thanks — i'll file the ticket now and include the exact log query and ttl=48h. assigning @sam to scrub + ops, @alex for iam script. will follow up with ticket link.

sam: sounds good. ping me when ticket is up and i'll queue the scrubber job.

alex: i'll prep the role and leave the removal command in the ticket.

maya: filed: https://jira.internal/browse/INT-1234 — added filter, justification, vendor contact. please review when you have a sec.
